evidence.dom: 【dom=空欄】FY2025(2025年6月期)10-K(CIK 0001383312, acc 0001628280-25-037656, br-20250630.htm)の Item1『Competition』節を含め全文精査したが、自社シェア%も上位N社合計%も開示されていない。■50側の構造記述: 『We operate in a highly competitive industry. Our Investor Communication Solutions business competes with companies that provide investor communication and corporate governance solutions, as well as our clients’ in-house operations. This includes independent proxy distribution service providers, transfer agents, proxy advisory firms, proxy solicitation firms, firms that process proxy votes, and financial printers. We also face competition from numerous firms in the compiling, printing and electronic distribution of statements, bills and other customer communications』『Within our Global Technology and Operations business, our capital markets solutions compete with in-house operations as well as vendors that provide trade processing, back-office record keeping, and sell-side order and execution management systems』→ 同等サービスの供給者が複数存在する記述。■50を否定する構造記述: 中核のICS(売上74.2%)の受益者proxyについて同10-Kは『Given the large number of Nominees involved in the beneficial proxy process ... we play a unique, central, and integral role in ensuring that the beneficial proxy process occurs without issue』『A large number of Nominees have contracted out the processes of distributing proxy materials and tabulating voting instructions to us』と自社の役割を unique / central と記し、GTO側も『provided fixed income trade processing services to 21 of the 25 primary dealers of fixed income securities in the U.S.』『provided services to the 15 largest U.S. wealth providers』と大手顧客のほぼ全数に浸透していると記す。これらは「自社<40%」を前提とする刻み50と両立しない。他方これらは顧客浸透率であってシェアではなく、上位N社構造も不明のため70/85も置けない(v9.9.41 規約2)。『We continue to be a leading provider of investor communications』『As a leader in global trade lifecycle management』は順位の自称で証拠にならない(規約4)。→ 刻みが散るため規約1により空欄。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025(6月期) br-20250630.htm Item1 Business/Competition, Item1A
evidence.irr: 『single source solution that spans the entire shareholder communications and corporate disclosure lifecycle』→統合プラットフォームからの移行は高摩擦だが、認証・規格ロックや唯一供給の明記はhitsになし→70(高摩擦移行困難)
evidence.rep: 同上の単一供給ライフサイクル網に加え、株主コミュニケーション/議決権処理の物理+デジタル配信規模。数十年/$10B級の明示的記述はhitsになく極困難(80)に留める
evidence.dur: 『the first step in passing voting rights down the chain is the omnibus proxy which DTC executes to transfer its voting rights to its participants』(DTC→participants→beneficial ownersの議決権処理チェーン=二面ネットワークインフラ)+『We monitor legislative and rulemaking activity by the SEC, FINRA, DOL, and the...IRS』(規制で裏打ち)→ネットワーク+規制補強=85
evidence.erosion: 蝕セクションのキーワードヒットなし+経常収入(規制起因)は継続成長→none
evidence.disrupt: 蝕ヒットなし+議決権/株主通信は規制義務(SEC proxy rules)で発行体↔受益者を仲介、DLT/デジタル化はBR自身が取込む立場→settled
evidence.expiry: 限セクションのヒットなし。コンセッション/特許束依存の期限型独占ではない→no
evidence.moatdecay: 経常収入成長継続・営業利益率上昇(13.6→17.3%)→no
evidence.geopol: 『The majority of our clients operate in the financial services industry. Our largest single client in each of our fiscal years...』→顧客が金融サービス業界に集中+最大単一顧客の存在。地理的には米国中心で地政学リスクは軽微だが業界集中があり→1(中)
evidence.nrr: hits非開示のため既定105(BRの顧客維持率は高いがNRRは未開示)
evidence.p2: COVID期の営業利益DD: FY2019 652.7→FY2020 624.9十億=-4.3%(浅い)。GFCはデータ期間外だが議決権/株主通信は規制起因の経常収入で構造的に非景気連動→95
evidence.p3: nde=2.26(<2.5)→70。実質net-debt/EBITDAはD&A考慮で~1.7とさらに低いが機械値2.26を採用
evidence.p4: accr=-3.9%(<0)+『Unresolved Staff Comments None』。hitsのmaterial weaknessは『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, and testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal control』=監査人のICFR監査手続の定型記述であり実指摘ではない→無限定・実指摘なしと判断→90
evidence.f1: ROIIC(2021→2025): ΔNOPAT+約$410M(532.8→942.5)に対しΔIC(込み)ほぼ横ばい〜減(Itiviti債務返済+自社株買い)で還元しつつ利益成長。込みROIC 16%−WACC~8.5%=+7.5pt級(WACC+8ティア)→80。ROIIC自体は極高だが脱レバレッジ由来の一過性を含むため過大評価せず
evidence.f2: TAM浸透%の開示なし。中核proxy/投資家コミュニケーションは高浸透・成熟、Global Technology & Operations(売上26%)は資本市場/ウェルスtechで余地あり→保守的に60(TAM浸透式のインフラ業態への当てはめは概念的に弱い旨注記)
evidence.f3: R&Dは単独開示なし(製品開発費が事業費に内包)業態。シェア趨勢: ICS 74-75%横ばい・経常収入+6-8%/年で中核地位維持=片方+→75。顧客集中の悪化証拠なく-10不適用
evidence.f4: 隣接事業: Global Technology and Operations segment revenues represented approximately 26% and 25% of total Revenues(FY2025/2024)=資本市場・ウェルスtechの隣接事業が売上5%超で成長→80
evidence.f5: disrupt=settled連動→85。規制義務の仲介インフラでDLT/デジタル化を自ら取込む
evidence.fin: 『The acquisition [Acolin] is expected to close in the first half of Broadridge's 2026 fiscal year...purchase price is approximately $70 million』+PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired系列(FY2021 Itiviti $2,603.6M等、5年累計~$2.8B)+のれん$3,609.6M→連続買収体(acq)
evidence.moatW: 【moatW=85 据置(原本で再確認)】Note 21 Financial Data by Segment / 収益分解(FY2025, 総額$6,889.1M): Investor Communication Solutions $5,113.0M=74.2%(内訳 Regulatory $1,280.6M=18.6%/Distribution $2,062.0M=29.9%/Customer communications $718.8M=10.4%/Data-driven fund solutions $459.2M=6.7%/Issuer $273.2M=4.0%/event-driven $319.3M=4.6%)、Global Technology and Operations $1,776.1M=25.8%(内訳 Capital markets $1,115.3M=16.2%/Wealth and investment management $660.8M=9.6%)。独立した堀2本: (1)ICS=DTC→Nominee→受益者の議決権伝達チェーンにpower of attorney で組み込まれた株主通信・議決権処理網(払い手は発行体・ファンド、根拠はSEC proxy rules)、(2)GTO=証券会社の約定処理・記帳の受託基盤(払い手はブローカー・ディーラー、根拠はスイッチングコストと規模の相互化)。両者は別プラットフォーム・別課金・別規制根拠で共通の中核技術に相乗りしておらず(v9.9.41 moatW追加規約)、片方が折れても他方は立つ。ICS内の Regulatory/Distribution/Customer communications は同一の配信基盤に乗るため合わせて1本と数える。各≥売上15%(74.2%/25.8%、GTO単独のCapital marketsでも16.2%)。3本目(Wealth 9.6%・Customer communications 10.4%)は15%未満。単一顧客集中もなし(『In fiscal year 2025, our largest client accounted for approximately 7% of our consolidated revenues』)。→ 独立2本=85。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025(6月期) acc 0001628280-25-037656 br-20250630.htm Note21/Item1/Item1A
